features.note: The North Fork Tuolumne River runs through the middle of camp.
Foxfire, a named programme area built around a working blacksmith forge.
An observatory used as an astronomy classroom under dark Sierra skies.
First-year campers start on the Trail to Eagle.
Eagle Achievement Camp sessions for older Scouts working Eagle-required merit badges.
